capture: Run ./gradlew --offline --no-daemon runGameTestServer with CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT_DROPS=on and CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT=write, then launch a new process with CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT=read in the same disposable world.
